source_scope: VCF textual specification versions 4.0 through 4.5. BCF binary conformance is a separate scope and is not inferred from VCF-text conformance.

sources.source_authority: International Genome Sample Resource (EMBL-EBI) historical archive candidate; original normative provenance unresolved
sources.qualification_note: The core VCFv4.0 page is retained as a discovery/reference candidate only. The separate 1000 Genomes SV page describes project-specific conventions/extensions and must not be merged into core VCFv4.0 requirements. No original source bytes or SHA-256 have been captured.
provenance_evidence: VCFtools historical specifications index explicitly says older VCF 4.0 documents are hosted on the 1000 Genomes wiki.
IGSR core page identifies itself as VCF version 4.0 and explicitly directs structural-variation conventions/extensions to a separate VCF_4.0_sv page.
sources.capture_blocker: The current web retrieval surface exposes rendered page content but not original HTTP response bytes; direct external download from the working container failed. No rendered-text reconstruction is hashed or accepted as original bytes.

sources.source_authority: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream; samtools/hts-specs
sources.raw_source_capture_method: Exact committed Git blob bytes retrieved through GitHub Base64 file-content response; decoded directly to bytes without text normalization; SHA-256 independently recomputed over the byte array.

source_stewardship.vcf4_0_note: VCFv4.0 is not listed among the maintained versioned specifications in the current HTS specifications index.
source_stewardship.archive_integrity_note: For VCFv4.1-4.5, archived .tex files were fetched back from the SIRALOOM branch and their Git blob SHA-1 values matched the corresponding authoritative hts-specs blobs; SHA-256 values in each source record were computed over the fetched UTF-8 source text.

status_vocabulary.source_pinned: Exact source revision and source-byte identity are fixed and independently verifiable.
status_vocabulary.candidate_extracted: Potential normative source locations were machine-extracted; they are not reviewed clauses.
status_vocabulary.reviewed_atomic_requirement: A human reviewer has decomposed and confirmed one independently verifiable obligation, permission, recommendation, or prohibition.
status_vocabulary.implemented: A production implementation symbol is mapped to the atomic requirement.
status_vocabulary.tested: Executable positive, negative, and applicable boundary tests are mapped and executed.
status_vocabulary.qualified: All applicable evidence gates are satisfied and independently reviewed; this is not equivalent to clinical assay validation.

next_gate: Acquire an immutable, provenance-qualified VCFv4.0 normative source and SHA-256; keep IGSR/1000 Genomes SV conventions in separate source records. Continue semantic decomposition and independent review before implementation mapping.
